hero.title: Public Health in Finland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Public Health in Finland offers Indian students the opportunity to study health promotion, epidemiology, health policy, nutrition, environmental health and other areas that address population-level health challenges. Finland offers internationally oriented, English-taught programmes such as the Master’s Degree Programme in Public Health at the University of Eastern Finland, a 2-year, 120 ECTS programme designed to prepare students for careers in public health, research, healthcare administration and global health.
